title: Formal Conjectures: An Open and Evolving Benchmark for Verified Discovery in Mathematics
abstract: arXiv:2605.13171v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: As automated reasoning systems advance rapidly, there is a growing need for research-level formal mathematical problems to accurately evaluate their capabilities. To address this, we present Formal Conjectures (https://github.com/google-deepmind/formal-conjectures), an evolving benchmark of currently 7559 mathematical problem statements formalized in Lean 4. Sourced from areas of active mathematical research, the dataset features 1642 open research conjectures without known solutions for mathematical proof discovery, 2923 solved problems for proof auto-formalization, and 2994 supporting statements. Notably, the repository provides a structured interface connecting mathematicians who formalize and clarify problems with the AI systems and humans attempting to solve them. Demonstrating its immediate utility, the benchmark has already been leveraged for new mathematical discoveries, including the resolution of open research conjectures,

translated_title: 形式化猜想：一个用于数学中经验证发现的开放且持续演进的基准测试
translated_abstract: 随着自动推理系统的快速发展，越来越需要研究级别的形式化数学问题来准确评估其能力。为解决这一问题，我们提出了形式化猜想，这是一个不断演进的基准测试，目前包含7559个用Lean 4形式化的数学问题陈述。该数据集来源于活跃的数学研究领域，包含1642个没有已知解的开放研究猜想（用于数学证明发现）、2923个已解决的问题（用于证明自动形式化）以及2994个辅助性陈述。值得注意的是，该仓库提供了一个结构化接口，将形式化和澄清问题的数学家与试图解决这些问题的AI系统和人类连接起来。该基准测试已经展现出其直接实用性，已被用于新的数学发现，包括对开放研究猜想的解决。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个包含7559个Lean 4形式化数学问题的开放且持续演进的基准测试，涵盖开放研究猜想、已解决问题和辅助陈述，并已成功助力新的数学发现。
en_tdlr: The paper presents Formal Conjectures, an open and evolving benchmark of 7559 Lean 4-formalized mathematical problems spanning open research conjectures, solved problems, and supporting statements, which has already enabled new mathematical discoveries.
